question_or_proposition: For Federal FY2025, does the nominated passage's identification of the NPDES authorization as a 'DRAFT' permit establish that numeric discharge limits and monitoring requirements stated in the associated permit documentation for NM0020583 are not enforceable applicable requirements for compliance evaluation during that fiscal year?
required_context: PERMIT ACTION: Proposed reissuance of the current National Pollutant Discharge Elimination System (NPDES) permit issued September 30, 2016, with an effective date of November 1, 2016, and an expiration date of October 31, 2021.
Permit number NM0020583 and fact sheet header identifying the document as the fact sheet for that permit
notes: The nominated span labels the permit as DRAFT. Purpose A requires distinguishing enforceable numeric limits from non-applicable monitoring, and Purpose B requires determining which monitoring requirements were actually applicable. Interpreting whether DRAFT denotes non-final/non-effective permit status versus administrative labeling could change whether limits and obligations sourced from this document are treated as enforceable for FY2025.
